description.zh: 云证书Id，type为cas的情况下需要输入该参数。
description.en: The cloud certificate ID. This parameter is required when Type is set to cas.

description.zh: 证书内容，type为upload类型时需要输入该参数。
description.en: The certificate content. This parameter is required when Type is set to upload.

description.zh: 证书Id，不支持 free 类型（通过接口ApplyCertificate创建）的证书 Id，可以支持 cas 和 upload 类型的证书 Id。
description.en: The certificate ID. Certificates of the free type (created by calling the ApplyCertificate operation) are not supported. Certificates of the cas and upload types are supported.
The keyless server ID. This parameter takes effect only when Type is set to keyless.

description.zh: 证书名称，type为upload类型时需要输入该参数。
description.en: The certificate name. This parameter is required when Type is set to upload.

description.zh: 证书私钥，type为upload类型时需要输入该参数。
description.en: The certificate private key. This parameter is required when Type is set to upload.

description.zh:
地域，type为cas的情况下需要输入该参数。

- 中国站账号传参数值：cn-hangzhou

- 国际站账号传参数值：ap-southeast-1
description.en:
The region. This parameter is required when Type is set to cas. Valid values:

- China site accounts: cn-hangzhou.

- International site accounts: ap-southeast-1.
The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation to obtain the site ID.

description.zh:
证书类型。

- **cas**：证书中心证书

- **upload**：自定义上传证书

- **keyless**：keyless证书
description.en:
The certificate type. Valid values:

- **cas**: certificate from SSL Certificates Service.

- **upload**: custom uploaded certificate.

- **keyless**: keyless certificate.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa set-certificate --site-id 1234567890123 --name yourCertName --cas-id 30000478 --type cas --certificate -----BEGIN_CERTIFICATE----- --biz-private-key -----BEGIN_PRIVATE_KEY----- --biz-region cn-hangzhou --id babae7c40fef412d887688b91c9e0000 --key-server-id 12331120000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun esa SetCertificate --region cn-hangzhou --SiteId 1234567890123 --Type cas --PrivateKey '-----BEGIN_PRIVATE_KEY-----' --Region 'cn-hangzhou' --Id babae7c40fef412d887688b91c9e0000 --CasId 30000478 --KeyServerId 12331120000 --Name yourCertName --Certificate '-----BEGIN_CERTIFICATE-----'
